    """Raise every nonzero object so its top row matches the highest object."""
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    occupied = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not occupied:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    target_top = min(r for r, _ in occupied)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r, c in occupied:
        out[r - (min(rr for rr, cc in occupied if grid[rr][cc] == grid[r][c]) - target_top)][c] = grid[r][c]
    return out
